caption_used: 该柱状图展示了2022年7月1日至8月26日期间全球每日新增新冠确诊病例数量与相关新闻媒体报道数量的变化趋势。蓝绿色柱状图表示当日确诊病例数，蓝色折线图表示新闻报道数量。整体来看，新闻报道数量在7月中旬达到峰值约4,200篇，随后呈现持续下降趋势；而确诊病例数在8月初出现明显高峰，单日最高超过1,200,000例。值得注意的是，两条数据序列在整个观测期间始终保持高度同步的正相关波动，未出现显著的时间滞后效应。

The vertical axis is divided into two sections. The left vertical axis represents the number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases, with a scale ranging from 0 to 1,200,000, and marked with intervals of 200,000. The right vertical axis represents the number of news articles published, ranging from 0 to 4,200, with intervals of 400. The data series consists of blue columns representing the number of new confirmed COVID-19 cases and a blue line representing the number of news articles published. The columns are clustered together, with each column representing a specific date. The blue columns generally increase and decrease in height, mirroring the trend of the blue line. The shortest column is approximately 200,000, while the tallest column reaches approximately 1,200,000. The blue line fluctuates between approximately 2,000 and 4,200. The chart is not sorted in any particular order.
